text:
Diego R: FYI console alerts: sudden jump in per-tenant quota burn for a handful of customers, started ~06:20 UTC.
Priya S: Any obvious root cause in ingress? headers, tokens, or payload size?
Diego R: short investig: requests now sometimes carry X-Quota-Namespace-V2 and the old X-Quota-Namespace at the same time. Proxy interprets them as separate namespaces -> double counting.
Kevin L: Hmm we rolled the SDK change last night that added V2 (more structured namespace). Some older clients still add the legacy header.
Asha M: Is proxy injecting anything? We had a shim that would add legacy header for compatibility in some regions.
Diego R: yes, the shim is on for eu-west and is configured to inject legacy when absent. But if SDK now sends V2, shim left the legacy in place for some flows and now both exist.
Priya S: Two classes of fixes: 1) server-side canonicalization in proxy/ingestion (map V2->canonical and drop legacy when both present), 2) require SDKs to stop sending legacy header and only send V2 (breaking change), 3) telemetry pipeline collapse at aggregation time.
Kevin L: Server-side mapping is safest short-term. But we must be careful: billing uses namespace string as key; canonicalizing will change ledger keys. Need audit trail.
Asha M: We could add an extra event field quota_namespace_source = ["sdk_v2","sdk_v1","shim_injected"] at ingestion so finance can reconcile later.
Priya S: Agreed. Add it as a string field with one of those values. Console dashboard parsers need to tolerate it.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: proxy-canary rolled to us-east-1 with patch proxy-header-canon v1.0.2
Diego R: Nice. For mapping, propose rule: if both headers present, prefer SDK V2 (it is explicit), set quota_namespace_source="sdk_v2" and drop legacy for enforcement and aggregation.
Kevin L: Sounds good. Also add a 14-day enforcement grace: for enforcement we maintain a mapping table that maps legacy->canonical for tenants that haven't migrated, to avoid sudden quota jumps.
Asha M: How will SDK release timing look? We need to coordinate Python/TS/Go clients to stop emitting legacy. That is a multi-week rollout.
Priya S: Devex should publish compatibility guidance and a migration lint rule for SDKs. devex-bot: devex-bot: created ticket DEVEX-512 for migration docs
Kevin L: We must ensure the console "quota burn" graphs mark the canary window and show pre/post canonicalization; otherwise product will get flooded with support tickets.
Diego R: I'll add a console tile showing ratio: only-v1 / only-v2 / both. Helps owners flip the flag per-tenant.
Asha M: Any risk to privacy or PII in the new V2 structure? It's more structured (org+app+env). We validated it doesn't include user ids right?
Priya S: Confirmed with SDK team: V2 sanitizes and hashes app id, no PII. I'll attach the spec in the PR.
Kevin L: Tests: add unit test for parser that receives both headers and verifies canonicalization + route_source annotation. Also an e2e test hitting proxy with mixed headers and validate billing ledger entries map to canonical namespace.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-ingestion patch deployed to telemetry-canary (v0.89)
Diego R: Quick rollout plan: 1) immediate proxy canonicalization + quota_namespace_source annotation (canary already) 2) ingestion collapse at aggregation + console tolerance (next 24h) 3) Devex guides + SDK lint + client updates (2-4 weeks) 4) schedule SDK deprecation window after metrics show <1% legacy traffic for 7 days.
Asha M: Owners: Diego (monitoring + proxy), Kevin (billing/ledger + ingestion contract), Priya (console + docs + SDK comms), Asha (QA + privacy).
Priya S: I'll add a banner in the console admin: "We are normalizing quota namespace headers for accurate billing. You may see temporary changes to quota graphs. See migration guide."
Kevin L: Also add an opt-in feature flag per-tenant to enable strict-only-v2 enforcement once they're migrated. Good for customers who want to enforce new namespaces early.
Diego R: Good idea. implement flag name: quota:enforce-v2-only. Default false.
devex-bot: devex-bot: posted migration draft -> https://git.internal/redwood/devex/migration/quota-namespace-v2 (PR DEVEX-512)
Asha M: Let's also reach out to top 10 customers directly; Kevin can help with a short note explaining the change and timeline.
Kevin L: Will do. I'll prepare billing reconciliation instructions and a small CSV export we can send if they ask.
Diego R: Summary checklist in thread: 1) proxy canonicalization canary (Diego) 2) ingestion annotation quota_namespace_source (Kevin) 3) console tile + banner + tenant ratio tile (Priya) 4) SDK migration docs + lint + client releases (Devex + SDK teams) 5) per-tenant strict flag and deprecation calendar (Product + Kevin) 6) customer comms to top customers (Kevin)
Priya S: I'll open console PRs and the banner copy now.
Diego R: I'll watch canary for 6 hours and report back. If no regressions, schedule region-by-region rollouts.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollouts at 1780020000
Kevin L: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in #billing-sync after the canary reflects stable metrics. :thumbsup:
